title: 宝塚記念の後に・粛々と

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tapping into every ounce of her strength, Grass Wonder prevails over Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scores of fans impacted by her running now have high expectations for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa visits Grass Wonder after the race and issues yet another challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with Silence Suzuka also scheduled to run, the Mainichi Okan is shaping up to become an intense race.
